description: List US auto loan / auto lease securitization trusts we track (from SEC EDGAR Reg AB II ABS-EE filings), optionally filtered by sponsor (captive-finance company / depositor, e.g. "Ally", "Toyota") or asset class. Use to find the exact trust name abs_trust_performance needs, or to see which sponsors/asset classes have coverage.

limit.description: Max trusts to return. Default 50, max 500.

sponsor.description: Case-insensitive substring match on the sponsor/depositor name, e.g. "Ally", "CarMax", "Exeter", "BMW".

name: abs_trusts
title: Abs Trusts
